humanScope: Primary post2024-09-24 bull-market research, net realized payoff and market liquidity; bear profit unnecessary. Numerical screens remain assistant proposals.
reason: Batch51/52 raw-price model arithmetic passed, but dated issuer notices explain two material held-price discontinuities and missing share/cash entitlements. Do not use these model account numbers as economic-return validation.
requirements: Archive dated primary issuer terms, publication/availability, registration, ex, share-availability and cash-pay dates. Future or later-finalized terms cannot enter an earlier decision.
Keep actual investor entitlements distinct from virtual ex-reference ratios;0.48 actual shares is not0.4796 reference ratio. Document exact source units and immutable hashes.

Represent share quantities, fractional allocation uncertainty, gross dividend receivables, paid cash and any deferred tax separately. Unknown is not zero. Do not invent broker-specific allocation or net cash.

Keep raw bars immutable. Define an explicit causal comparable-price feature basis for prior returns, ranks and support windows. Never silently relabel adjusted prices as raw or apply a latest forward-adjusted series to past decisions.

Apply documented action and reference changes exactly once to risk-entry/peak/ratchet units; do not double-adjust through both preclose and a declared action. Keep the real market move after ex-reference adjustment.

Retain quarantine for unexplained/conflicting events. Do not remove the safety gate, drop affected stocks after seeing outcomes, cancel saved exits or hand-adjust final equity to create better returns.

The old VolatilityTrailAccount explicitly rejects declared corporateActions. Implement any extended support as an isolated version under a new contract, not a mutable-data or constructor-guard workaround.

Synthetic independent cash/share/price/fee fixtures must cover pure cash, pure split, combined differential distribution, fractional uncertainty, deferred cash/tax, partial fills, lot locks, action-order timing and rollback. No new market account until these pass.

Rebuild every affected signal, opening decision and account from the original start with a frozen corrected-source/feature version. An event changes rankings, fills and future cash/slots, so correcting only the two final holdings cannot validate the strategy.
Preserve all earlier studies and failure evidence. Register source/algorithm changes as a new experiment; no retroactive claim that prior raw-price trials were economically certified.
